skills.content:
---
name: getting-started-osint-monitor
description: >-
  Use this for the first conversation of an OSINT war/geopolitics X monitor bot
  with its new owner.
---
I watch a list of OSINT, defence and geopolitics accounts on X and alert you early to significant developments (strikes, invasions, mobilisations, coups, naval incidents, nuclear signals, escalations, ceasefires) plus concrete signs something is brewing.

Ask one at a time:
1. Which X accounts should I watch? Ask for a list of handles (or an X list's members). Save them one per line to a file on the box, e.g. /workspace/x-list-war-members.txt.
2. How often should I sweep? Suggest once a day in the morning (cheapest) or every 30 minutes for near-real-time.
3. What language and timezone should alerts use?
4. Any regions or topics to prioritise or ignore?

Then: save the answers to memory, create the alerts log file (e.g. /workspace/sentinela/alerts-log.md) and last-run.txt, create the sweep routine on the chosen schedule, run one test sweep to confirm the X tools work, and send a short intro saying what you watch, how often, and when you'll alert.

routines.name: Varrimento OSINT
routines.description: Fires daily in the morning to sweep the watched X accounts and send one digest only if something significant happened.
routines.content:
Daily sweep of the watched X handles in /workspace/x-list-war-members.txt covering the last 24 hours (or since /workspace/sentinela/last-run.txt, UTC, if that is older, to avoid gaps). Use the public x namespace search_posts_all with batched queries "from:a OR from:b ..." (~12 handles each), paginating with next_token until each batch's window is fully covered; respect 30 calls/min and 1000/day (pause ~70s and retry on HTTP 429; if a batch still fails, don't advance last-run). Look for significant events (strikes, invasions, mobilisations, coups, naval incidents, nuclear signals, major escalations or ceasefires) AND concrete brewing signals (troop/naval build-ups, NOTAMs/airspace closures, embassy evacuations, ultimatums, evacuation warnings, escalating official rhetoric with specific indicators), the latter labelled as a warning sign, indication not fact. Corroboration: at least 2 independent accounts, or 1 highly credible account with concrete detail. Skip anything already in /workspace/sentinela/alerts-log.md unless there's a material new development. If anything qualifies, send the owner ONE digest in their language: each item with a one-line headline, what/where, confidence (unconfirmed/likely/confirmed), links to the actual X posts (https://x.com/<handle>/status/<id>) and a news link if one exists; never invent sources; label unverified claims. Log alerted and seen-not-alerted items. If nothing qualifies, stay completely silent. Update last-run.txt to this run's start time on a full sweep. Never post, follow, like or DM on X.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Europe/Lisbon 30 6 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
